title: ycc package-model manifest
description: Machine-readable record of the v6 package model from ADR 0001 (docs/internal/adr/0001-package-model-and-versioning.md): every workflow package, per runtime, with catalog-listing state, mechanism, components, dependencies, gates, and evidence. `listed` records production catalog visibility TODAY and is generator input, never a runtime field. `installer-fallback` is an internal modeling key for install.sh-only artifacts, not a public installable package id. Independently versioned items such as status-bar@ycc-mods stay outside this manifest; every entry here is lockstep.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, kept relative to the manifest.

schema_version.description: Manifest format revision; bumped on breaking changes only.

version_source.description: The single lockstep version field every workflow package follows.

packages.description: Package key to package definition. installer-fallback models install.sh-only artifacts and is not a public installable package id.

description.description: One-line summary of what the package ships.

version_policy.description: Every entry is lockstep with the product version. Independently versioned items (e.g. status-bar@ycc-mods) are excluded from this manifest by design.

runtimes.description: Runtime to per-runtime package entry; a runtime appears only where the package exists there.

status.description: v6.0.0 state: shipped or planned (included), rejected (excluded), or pushed to a later release (deferred).

listed.description: Production catalog visibility today: true only for the shipping claude ycc entry. Generator input, not a runtime field.

mechanism.description: How the package reaches the user: a native plugin manifest, an npm package, or install.sh file copy.

components.description: Components the package carries; empty only for meta packages that only declare requires.

requires.description: Bare-name dependencies; only Claude native packages may declare them.

target_release.description: Release a deferred or planned listing targets; deferred entries cannot target v6.0.0.

experimental.description: True when the mechanism or package shape is still experimental.

opt_in.description: True when users must explicitly opt in; never the default install.

evidence.description: Repo-relative spike dossiers or ADR paths backing the row; must exist on disk.

gates.description: Proof gates from RELEASING.md that must pass before the listing flip.

notes.description: Row-specific context: version floors, no-go reasons, and installer ownership.
